pb-online-seller.title: Seller desk
pb-online-seller.line: Check the seller exports before drafting changes.
pb-online-seller.manual: You upload every marketplace change yourself.
pb-online-seller.fileHelp: Use the blank sheet if your export has different columns.
pb-online-seller.locked: Choose an order and add a seller export first.
pb-online-seller.none: No checks yet. Add the seller export to begin.
pb-online-seller.rubric: Our own rubric. Check your marketplace category rules before uploading.
pb-online-seller.noScore: No score until the missing fields are added.
pb-online-seller.manualImage: Check the main image background by eye.
pb-online-seller.estimateClaim: Estimate for review, not receivable. Nothing submitted. The seller files.
pb-online-seller.notBuying: This is not a buying decision.
pb-online-seller.noBreakEven: Break-even needs the report's sales basis and a tied economics sheet.
pb-online-seller.receiptLine: Code computed these figures from the source file shown below.
pb-online-seller.error.SELLER_INPUT_INVA: The export needs the named columns and source details. Use the blank sheet.
pb-online-seller.error.UNIT_ECONOMICS_HO: This sheet is held. Add the missing cost or fee evidence.
pb-online-seller.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: Client tax and India declaration checks wait for CA or lawyer confirmation. Practice uses the unconfirmed rules.
pb-online-seller.error.UPLOAD_LIMIT: Use a CSV file smaller than one megabyte.
pb-online-seller.error.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Choose an open order in this business.
pb-online-seller.error.generic: This check could not run. Check the source file and try again.
pb-online-seller.question.title: Upload the listing title to unlock this check.
pb-online-seller.question.bullets: Upload the product bullets to unlock this check.
pb-online-seller.question.description: Upload the product description to unlock this check.
pb-online-seller.question.images: Add product images to the order to unlock their checks.
pb-online-seller.finding.TITLE_PROMOTION: Remove promotional or subjective wording from the title.
pb-online-seller.finding.TITLE_LONG: Check the category title limit and move extra details into the bullets.
pb-online-seller.finding.IMAGE_SMALL: Use a larger product image for zoom readiness.
pb-online-seller.finding.PRICE_ABOVE_MRP: Ask the seller to set a price within the package MRP.
pb-online-seller.finding.ORIGIN_REQUIRED: Add the country of origin from the package.
pb-online-seller.finding.SELLER_DETAILS_: Add the seller's name and contact details.
pb-online-seller.photosHelp: Add the original photos to check their header dimensions.
pb-online-seller.mismatch: The ads report does not reconcile.
pb-online-seller.ownPrice: Set the own-shop offer price in your plan first.
